read.thesis: Cloud external revenue +45% and AI-product run rate RMB 49.5bn, but capex RMB 67.7bn and FCF outflow RMB 44.7bn; supply is being added aggressively with compute demand said to exceed supply.

utilisation.quote: compute demand will continue to outstrip supply

capex.quote: CapEx was RMB 67.7 billion this quarter, reflecting our continued investments in AI infrastructure to meet strong and growing customer demand.

triggers.label: Capex RMB 67.7bn, +75% YoY
triggers.quote: CapEx was RMB 67.7 billion this quarter, reflecting our continued investments in AI infrastructure

triggers.label: FCF outflow RMB 44.7bn
triggers.quote: Free cash flow was an outflow of RMB 44.7 billion compared to an outflow of RMB 18.8 billion

triggers.label: Cloud EBITDA margin 11.6%→12%
triggers.quote: The adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 12%, driven by improved economies of scale and a stronger pricing power of AI-related products amid tight market supply.
triggers.highlight: stronger pricing power of AI-related products

triggers.label: Cloud external revenue +45%, 22-quarter high
triggers.quote: Alibaba Cloud's external revenue growth accelerated to 45%, a 22 quarter high

triggers.label: MaaS ARR target RMB 30bn reaffirmed
triggers.quote: we remain confident that we will achieve our year-end target of RMB 30 billion ARR by the end of the year
triggers.highlight: year-end target of RMB 30 billion ARR

guidance.quote: we are confident the growth rate will further accelerate in the coming quarters
we expect EBITDA margin to further expand steadily in the coming quarters
we remain confident that we will achieve our year-end target of RMB 30 billion ARR by the end of the year
we're highly confident in our ability to achieve our goal of RMB 100 billion in external cloud revenue by 2030
The Quick Commerce business is expected to achieve overall profitability in FY '29

red_flags.label: FCF outflow RMB 44.7bn, capex +75%
red_flags.quote: Free cash flow was an outflow of RMB 44.7 billion compared to an outflow of RMB 18.8 billion in the same quarter last year.

red_flags.label: AI Labs loss RMB 13.9bn
red_flags.quote: AI Lab and Applications comprises AI model labs Qwen Consumer Business Group and QwenWork. Its adjusted EBITDA was a loss of RMB 13.9 billion

evasions.topic: Capex budget update vs RMB 380bn plan
evasions.quote: I don't think we should take the spending for this quarter and multiply it by 4
So I don't think that there's any government-led compute supply allocation scheme
